entities.summary: San Salvatore dei Fieschi, also known as the Basilica dei Fieschi is a Romanesque-Gothic style church, now converted into a parish church and minor basilica, located on Piazza Innocenzo IV in a hamlet of San Salvatore, a neighborhood of the commune of Cogorno in the Metropolitan City of Genoa, region of Liguria, Italy.
